I am getting old now, 61 years, and my barley plot is small but it feeds my household through the year. I will try to get some DAP and urea from the cooperative like last season, but only a little because the price is high and my pension from farming is thin — I will put maybe one small sack across the plot. I still use my own barley seed that I saved from last harvest, it grows well enough here in the highlands and I cannot afford the improved seed every year. My sons help me with the oxen for ploughing, and I will hire a few people only for weeding and harvest since my back is not strong anymore.
